title_template: {work_unit_id} — Human-by-Exception steady-state policy under existing authority only
goal: Define and validate a fail-closed Human-by-Exception steady-state policy that re-evaluates fresh Provider Truth, control-loop, execution admission and operationalization for every iteration, permits at most one delegated existing-authority transaction per iteration, and requires exact readback before any next iteration.
scope: define per-iteration fresh Provider Truth, control-loop, execution-admission and Human-by-Exception operationalization requirements
permit at most one delegated transaction per iteration and only through an exact already-canonical authority
require fresh exact readback after a delegated transaction before any subsequent iteration
forbid stale control-loop, admission or operationalization reuse across iterations
preserve OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED as owner-visible no-mutation no-replay behavior
preserve WAIT_ONLY as no-mutation no-replay behavior
preserve SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED and BLOCKED as fail-closed behavior
prepare machine-verifiable steady-state execution criteria without granting new authority
forbidden_scope: create, infer or broaden provider-state, issue, branch, pull-request, merge, runtime, product, release, ruleset, ADWF or higher-autonomy authority
batch multiple delegated mutations into one iteration
reuse stale Provider Truth, control-loop, execution admission or operationalization decisions
weaken exact Writer Lease, branch, pull-request, CI, provider-state or canonical-main binding requirements
weaken OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED, WAIT_ONLY, STOP_ONLY, SEPARATE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED, BLOCKED or no-replay semantics
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime
mutate ADWF binding/repository, release/tag/promotion, ruleset/security policy, PRIVATE evidence or 1080/1081 lifecycle
exit_criteria: steady-state policy deterministically requires fresh inputs for every iteration
maximum delegated transaction count remains one per iteration
fresh exact readback is mandatory before a next iteration
automatic continuation remains limited to explicit already-canonical delegated authority
owner escalation, WAIT, STOP, separate-authority and BLOCKED remain distinct no-mutation/fail-closed outcomes
steady-state policy grants no new mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
